amount.description: Amount of archives to show, with a link to the archive page for the rest. Will show all if not set

group_by.description: Whether to group the archives by month or by year. Groups by month if not set

order.description: 1 to show the oldest archives first, or -1 to show the newest first. Shows the newest first if not set

format.description: Moment.js format of the archive names, such as 'MMMM YYYY' (by month) or 'YYYY' (by year), which are used if not set

show_count.description: Whether to show the number of posts of each archive
